name: hung-quynh-our-story
description: Static memory timeline website for Hùng and Quỳnh.

scripts.prestart: npm run prepare:media && npm run generate:memories
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:media && npm run validate:memories && npm run generate:memories
scripts.build:pages: npm run prebuild && ng build --configuration production --base-href /hung-quynh-our-story/ && npm run prepare:static && npm run verify:artifact
scripts.build:dev: npm run prebuild && ng build --configuration development
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/lib/memory-scanner.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-memories.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-memory-index.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-static-host.mjs && node --check scripts/migrate-memory-images.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-media-variants.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-static-artifact.mjs
